chapter: Carnegie Hall and the touring years
title: His sister, his mother's house and the Joe Turner Blue Room
summary: A sister lives in California; he bought the house for his mother and ran the chicken shack Blue Room during the war.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: I got two...I got a sister lives here in California, and the house we in right now, I bought it for my mother about twenty years ago, and I was livin' at Ninety-Ninth and Central, out near Watts. I had a place out there they called the Joe Turner Blue Room. It was a chicken shack.
